name: Sjuhäradsleden, etapp 1: Hindås station - Hestrafors IF
description: Hindås station to Hestrafors IF. Candidate import from normalized research; verify current notices before publication.
waterSources: Public drinking water tap, Hindås: Mapped as amenity=drinking_water and man_made=water_tap near the station area.
Public drinking water tap, Hindås: undefined
notes: Official municipal/tourism pages state 13 km; Naturkartan says 13.6 km and computes to 13.611 km; OSM computes around 13.657 km; AllTrails reports 13.8 km; Wikiloc user track is about 14.44 km.

Västsverige/Härryda says Etapp 1 starts at Hindås station, but also says Sjuhäradsleden begins at Hindåsgården. Official map and GPX support a Hindås station stage start with route passing Hindåsgården.
Official section label says Hestrafors IF, OSM relation says to=Brandshed, and the Naturkartan/OSM route endpoint is about 350-400 m south of Borås's Hestrafors IF/Bollevi coordinate.
Borås describes the trail generally as well signposted, while Naturkartan warns the whole trail is not fully quality-assured and field reports include both good-marking and weak-marking experiences.
Official descriptions emphasize forest, small paths and forest roads. Recent AllTrails reviews complain that much of the stage is asphalt/gravel/transport-like.

Official pages/map legend show access symbols, but no official source confirms stage-specific toilet, shelter or water facilities on Etapp 1. OSM/Naturkartan third-party objects identify several nearby candidates.

facilities.name: Hindås station trailhead / parking
facilities.description: Official Etapp 1 start. Borås Stad says parking and information are at Hindås station. Parking has multiple nearby mapped candidates; keep with commute/access rather than normal trail facilities unless parking is globally imported.

facilities.name: Public drinking water tap, Hindås
facilities.description: Mapped as amenity=drinking_water and man_made=water_tap near the station area. Operational status and seasonality are not confirmed by an official municipal source.

facilities.name: ICA Nära Hindås
facilities.description: Convenience grocery near the start; OSM lists opening hours Mo-Su 07:00-22:00. Commercial hours should be verified at integration time.

facilities.name: Västra Nedsjön badplats, Hindås
facilities.description: Municipal bathing place with jetties, toilet, grill place, grass, diving tower and swings; HaV also notes benches and waste bins. Bathing-place toilets/grill/waste service may be seasonal; confirm exact toilet coordinate and public opening at integration.

facilities.name: Hjortviken Country Club / Hindåsgården area
facilities.description: Commercial hotel/spa by Västra Nedsjön; official site lists rooms, restaurants, pool club and bars. Route passes the Hindåsgården/Hjortviken area. Do not assume toilets or water are publicly available to non-guests.

facilities.name: Hindås Pizzeria
facilities.description: Restaurant in Hindås west of the station-area trailhead. Hours and current status not confirmed.

facilities.name: Bykrogen Milano
facilities.description: Restaurant in Hindås west of the station-area trailhead. Hours and current status not confirmed.

facilities.name: Pump Hindås
facilities.description: Fuel/service point near the Hindås/Hindåsgården corridor; OSM opening hours show 24/7. Useful service metadata, not a hiking facility.

facilities.name: Petaredbackens byalag picnic shelter
facilities.description: OSM shelter_type=picnic_shelter very close to Etapp 1. OSM-only; no official maintenance/access source found. Treat as picnic/rest shelter, not confirmed overnight wind shelter.

facilities.name: Hestrafors IF / Bollevi endpoint access
facilities.description: Official Etapp 1 end / Etapp 2 start access cluster. Borås/Västsverige note parking and information at Hestrafors IF clubhouse; Hestrafors IF page notes paved parking and accessible toilet work at Bollevi. Do not merge this coordinate into the GPX route endpoint without explicit trail-manager confirmation. Toilet may be clubhouse/event access, not guaranteed public.
